arguments.hindsight: The initial slice grasp worked, but the cross-body transfer required rotations that compromised it and caused arm interference. A planned handoff in clear space, or repositioning the toaster within the picking arm’s reach before lifting bread, would avoid this recovery problem.
arguments.reason: I could not recover the first slice into an upright insertion pose after it slipped across the toaster opening. Repeated recovery approaches encountered the rim or failed to secure the bread.

calls.tool_result: Acknowledged give_up.
